title: OreImouto Language Pack Manifest
description: Metadata specification for OreImouto Re:Port language translation packs.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema definition.

id.description: Unique package identifier (e.g., lang_en, lang_ru, lang_zh_cn).

locale.description: ISO 639-1 / BCP 47 locale code (e.g., en, ru, zh_CN, ja).

name.description: Native display name of the language (e.g., Русский, English, 简体中文).

short.description: 3-letter uppercase badge label (e.g., RUS, ENG, ZHO).

version.description: Semantic version of the translation pack (e.g., 1.0.0).

description.description: Detailed description of the translation pack.

team.description: Translating team or group name (e.g., Elevation, Rinjinbu Translations).

translators.description: List of individual translators and contributors.

tags.description: Status tags (e.g., partial, beta) mapped to Markdown tooltip explanations, or an array of tag strings.

fonts.description: Custom font mappings for the locale (ui, dialogue, speaker, accent, fallback).

links.description: External links (website, discord, vk, romhacking, etc.).
